description: This file defines the MyContactsDashlet class, which extends DashletGeneric and provides a custom dashlet for displaying contacts in SuiteCRM. It initializes dashlet data, sets up search fields, columns, and the seed bean for the dashlet.

classes.name: MyContactsDashlet
classes.description: A custom dashlet class for displaying contacts, inheriting from DashletGeneric, setting up search fields, columns, and seed bean.
